## Choose your next goal

have the prerequisite skills, choose the software-development or scientific-data
path that matches what you want to build.

## Two pathways, one foundation

::: {.concept-diagram}
The foundation course branches into software engineering and scientific-data
pathways.

```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
%%| eval: true
flowchart LR
  F[Python Foundations]
  I[Intermediate Python:<br/>Applied Problem Solving]
  A[Advanced Python:<br/>Complex Problem Solving]
  S[Scientific Computing]
  M[Data Science and Machine Learning]
  F --> I --> A
  F --> S --> M
  I -. recommended .-> M
```

:::

::: {.callout-note title="Course status and certificates"}
Foundations has 38 required lessons across 20 concept-focused instructional
units, 20 required unit challenges, and a final-project rubric. Intermediate
and Advanced are clearly marked **TBD** while their challenge-based curricula
are designed. Scientific and Data/ML remain in development while their applied
projects and assessment coverage grow. Certificates are planned; browser
completion is not a verified credential.
:::
